{{Quote|Taris, Tatooine, Nar Shaddaa and Alderaan--four worlds, hundreds of elite soldiers and five deadly traitors to deal with. You have your work cut out for you, Lieutenant.|General Garza|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''SpecForce Incident''' was a name given to the events surrounding the [[3643 BBY]] defection on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] of all but [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|one]] member of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] unit known as [[Havoc Squad]]. Later these defectors persuaded thousands of other Republic Special Forces members to defect to [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They were all pursued and tracked down by the new formation of the Havoc Squad in the months following.
